reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is completely off-topic: it addresses magnetocaloric properties of FeNiMnSiGe thin films, not residual stress, mechanical properties, or processing of AlCrFeNiSi powder for additive manufacturing.
reasons.testability: The described tests (SQUID, TEM, AFM) are for magnetic and structural characterization of thin films, not for measuring residual stress or mechanical properties of additively manufactured components.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis provides no useful intervention for the stated problem of residual thermal stresses and degraded mechanical properties in AlCrFeNiSi additively manufactured components.
